item.title: [Lanka Talks] Seylan Bank Men’s Basketball Team Scripts Historic Triumph: Clinches Mercantile A Division Title After 29 Years
item.description: In a historic sporting milestone, the Seylan Bank Men’s Basketball Team emerged winners of the 34th Mercantile Services Basketball League Tournament 2026 – Men’s A Division, securing the coveted title with a decisive 73-61 victory in the final and liftin the trophy for the first time in 29 years since their last A Division championship victory in 1997.
